kpis.description_fr: Bitcoin détenus fin FY24. Plus grand corporate holder mondial. Stratégie 'Bitcoin Treasury Reserve' via émissions equity+convertibles.
kpis.description_en: Bitcoin held end FY24. Largest corporate holder globally. 'Bitcoin Treasury Reserve' strategy via equity+convertibles issuance.

kpis_story.description_fr: Annonce Oct 2024 : plan '21/21' = $21Md equity + $21Md fixed income sur 3 ans pour accélérer BTC accumulation. Cible BTC yield 6-10%/an. Rebaptisé 'Strategy' Feb 2025.
kpis_story.description_en: Oct 2024 announcement: '21/21' plan = $21Bn equity + $21Bn fixed income over 3 years to accelerate BTC accumulation. 6-10%/year BTC yield target. Rebranded 'Strategy' Feb 2025.

_notes: Bitcoin treasury proxy. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
